params.body:
Two small things on the daily bidding mail, both from reading it with Shane after #705 went out.

**The button went to the front page.** "Bekijk in Stocklist Dealer" linked to `https://traders.stocklistdealer.eu`, so a dealer who had just read about twelve biddings landed on his dashboard and had to find them himself. It points at `/bidding-offers` now, which is what the mail is about.

**The recipient's own bidding stays in the list, and that is now a decision instead of a leftover.** The query carried this line, commented out, for years:

```php
//vehicles.dealer_id != '.$dealer_id.' and
```

It reads like something that still had to be switched on — the mail on creation does skip the owner, and `BiddingMailsTest` pins that. Shane decided on 21 September that the daily mail is a different thing: it is an overview, and a dealer wants to see his own vehicle in it to be sure it is running. So the line is replaced by a comment saying that, R B1-2.4 says it, and a test holds it in place, so a later clean-up cannot quietly remove what looks like dead code.

Fixes nothing new; refines R B1-2.4 and the mail from #705.
params.title: The button goes to the biddings, and your own car stays in the list
